# CANDIDATE: VIX_LOW_RIBBON_BOS_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis
When market volatility is suppressed (low VIX) and the EMA ribbon is bullish, a bullish break of structure after a higher low offers a low‑risk long entry. This combines VIX filtering with structural price action to capture low‑volatility trend continuations that existing VIX‑gated setups miss.

## Mechanism
Entry rule: Require VIX < 15, EMA8 > EMA21 > EMA55 (bullish ribbon), price forms a higher low (low > prior low) then closes above the prior swing high (break of structure, BOS) with close > that high and close > open (bullish bar). Enter at the close of the BOS bar.  
Exit shape: Stop placed at the prior swing low that defined the higher low (structure invalidation) or 0.6×ATR below entry, whichever is tighter; primary target at 2×R, with remaining position trailed using a premium‑stop % (15% of ATR) to capture extension.  
Regime hint: Ideal in low‑volatility regimes (VIX < 15) and during the mid‑day window (11:00‑13:30 ET) when trend‑following signals are less prone to false breakouts.
